test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An athlete crosses a distance of 3600 m in 12 minutes. What is his speed (in km/h)?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 3600 m

Time = 12 minutes

**Concept Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ We know that 1 km = 1000 m

⇒ 3600 m = (3600)/(1000)=3.6km

⇒ 1 hour = 60 minutes

⇒ So, 12 minutes = (12)/(60)=0.2 hrs

⇒ Speed of an athlete = (3.6)/(0.2)=18 km/h

**Hence, the speed of an athlete is 18 km/h.**
